messages.text:
The Q.1 is $248 and ships October 15 — a real miner drawing for a full block every ten minutes, and you still own it after every draw.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup already running?
Read the nexus qx1 8th s page

For a first miner the QX1 is a good one: $248, about 170 W, under 50 dB, and the power supply is in the box. At 16¢ a kWh that's roughly $20 a month to run, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes while you learn how pools and wallets actually work.

Want me to set one up for you?
how much can I earn for month wiht thia one?

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. What you're buying is the draw: every ten minutes the QX1 takes a shot at a full block, 3.125 BTC, and you still own the machine after every draw. Pointed at a pool instead, it stacks small steady sats straight to your own wallet, no exchange, no KYC.

Shall I get one in the cart for you?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the NEXUS QX1 numbers for where you live.
